node.title: DSP8 nodal cube-preimage envelope
node.statement: All singular-trace subgroup points combine into one affine intersection of the cube-preimage subgroup K={x:x^3 in H}, of order gcd(3,p-1)n. Applying the Mattarei affine-pair theorem to both this fiber and every twisted quotient fiber lowers the class-weighted raw nodal DSP8 contribution below 116n^2 when p=2 mod 3 and below 498n^2 when p=1 mod 3. Both fit the live allowance, leaving more than 1443n^2 in the three-root case; the smooth quotient-weighted correlation remains open.
